scientific_disposition.stage1: completed and scored after strict prediction freeze

inclusion_policy.include: canonical metadata, reviewed code/tests, truth-free public observation indexes, immutable task-sized predictions/diagnostics/candidates, numeric Stage1 scores and final stratified summary, gate audit, strict validation, and safe allowlisted watchdog command/guard/time/sample/finish receipts
inclusion_policy.exclude: private truth/evaluator/holdout source rows and indexes, large observation/model/prototype/projected-table assets, mutable development payloads, old backups/patches, smoke receipts, and optional stdout/stderr
inclusion_policy.root_state: coordination/STATE.json is protected readonly evidence only; P03 did not modify or stage the global state file.
inclusion_policy.self_hash_policy: manifest.json and publication-files.json intentionally omit their own hash; root computes final bundle hashes after staging
